title: Claude Code stdio MCP registration has no supported cwd field
summary: A "cwd" key in ~/.claude.json's mcpServers entries is silently ignored by Claude Code (confirmed via claude mcp add --help and claude mcp get, which never expose it) -- this was the real root cause behind tsx path-alias and module-resolution failures previously misattributed to dotted tool names.
retrievalQuestions: Does Claude Code support a cwd field for stdio MCP server registrations?
Why does an MCP server registered with a cwd key still resolve modules from the wrong directory?
What is the correct way to set a working directory for a Claude Code stdio MCP server?

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: A stdio MCP server needs to run with a specific working directory (e.g. to resolve tsconfig path aliases or relative imports)
startAt: ~/.claude.json mcpServers entry for the server in question
doNot: Add a "cwd" field to a Claude Code stdio MCP server entry and assume it takes effect
Assume module-resolution failures from a stdio MCP server are caused by tool-naming conventions before checking the working directory it actually launched from
proveBeforeClaiming: claude mcp get <server-name> output does not display a cwd field even if one was set
The server's command wraps in bash -c "cd <repo> && exec node ..." and the tool that previously failed now succeeds via a real tools/call
